 Pokhara set 218-run target for Karnali in NPL 
 Nepal News 
 November 9, 2026 
 1 MIN READ 
 A 
 A+ 
 A- 
 content_copy 
 bookmark_border 
 KATHMANDU: The Pokhara Avengers scored 217 for three in 20 overs to set Karnali Yaks a target of 218 in the Nepal Premier League (NPL) match on Monday.
 After winning the toss and choosing to bat at the TU International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur, Pokhara posted the highest total of the ongoing season and the second-highest in NPL history. Biratnagar Kings hold the record with 220 runs against Pokhara in the 2025 edition.
 Yuvraj Samra scored 102 off 48 balls, including 10 fours and six sixes, while Kushal Bhurtel made 62 off 39 balls with seven sixes. They shared a 136-run partnership for the second wicket, the highest for any wicket in NPL history.
 Samra’s century was the first of this season’s tournament. Captain Chamika Karunaratne added an unbeaten 25 off 11 balls.
 Karnali captain Sompal Kami took two wickets for 24 runs in four overs, while Mark Watt claimed one wicket.
